raw_segments.text: Emilia, a halter pardon him and hell gnaw his bones. Why should he call her whore? Who
keeps her company? What place? What time? What form? What likelihood? The Moors abused
by some most villainous knave, some base notorious knave, some scurvy fellow. Oh, heaven, that
such companions thou'dst unfold and put in every honest hand a whip to lash the rascals
naked through the world even from the east to the west.
